Completed Phase 03: End-to-End Regression & Zero-Deprecation Verification with global warning trap tests.

errors_encountered.error: [DEP0169] DeprecationWarning: url.parse() behavior is not standardized and prone to errors that have security implications. Use the WHATWG URL API instead.
errors_encountered.solution: Replaced legacy url.parse() with WHATWG new URL(req.url, 'http://127.0.0.1') in BridgeServer; verified zero deprecation warnings with process.on('warning') trap.

errors_encountered.error: Prompt dispatched twice into chat during phase execution due to duplicate click events.
errors_encountered.solution: Eliminated redundant button.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click')) after native button.click() in dispatchButtonClickCascade, re-injected DOM bridge into workbench.

decisions_made: Use WHATWG URL API across all HTTP request parsing in BridgeServer
Enforce single mutually exclusive submit strategy (buttonClick OR enterKey OR formSubmit) to prevent double chat messages
Use scanPlanFolderAsync across all orchestrator execution and quickpick workflows
